Use these components instead of writing raw Tailwind flex/grid classes. They enforce consistent spacing and responsive breakpoints across the app. **Important:** Tailwind CSS does not support dynamic class construction (e.g. `` `flex-${direction}` ``). All layout components use static lookup maps to generate classes.
